ptr.note: AVClass-enabled logging context or NULL (general log). Read only: av_vlog reads the class's version and log_level_offset_offset (then the int at that offset), format_line reads class_name/item_name, parent_log_context_offset (then the parent pointer and its class) and get_category. Borrowed for the call; the installed callback receives it unchanged. Rust: a LogContext (an ObjectRef converts into one; Record::context hands a callback the one it receives). [symbol] Returns snprintf's result: negative on error, else the untruncated length. va_list used through va_copy only.
